name: UPSSSC
body: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
exam: UPSSSC online applications (guideline names no advertisement or year)

source.title: GuideLines for Scanning Photograph with Signature

uploads.label: Photograph
rules: Scan only the photo area, not the whole page.
conflicts: Point 4 says 50KB to 100KB; the sample specification on the same page says under 50 KB. This preset uses point 4. Check what the live form accepts.

uploads.label: Signature
rules: Sign in full; initials are not accepted.
Must be signed by the applicant, and must match the signature at the exam.
conflicts: Point 4 says 20KB to 50KB; point 5 and the sample specification say under 20 KB. This preset uses point 4. Check what the live form accepts.

notes: The guideline page is undated and names no advertisement, so these are the least certain figures of all the presets.
The page does not mention a live photo capture.
The sample scan on the page uses 200 dpi, True Colour.
